description: A pike formation's brace (P30, plan M6-M9 sections 2.10 and 5.11): one band attack for the whole formation, run by the front-rank member nearest the giant while the giant is within the formation's brace_m of its front rank. A band (hit_shape band_pulse) as wide as the front rank and 6 m deep (radius_m) strikes once per pulse: one hit per target, one telegraph, one of the target's two melee tokens. It strikes as a 5 m attacker (the formation's brace_height_m), so its 100 poise reaches a stage-4 giant's legs as about 45; its damage keeps size_policy none. Blockable, not parryable.
